messages:
Nina (AE): Quick sync — NewLeaf wants staging access but their procurement requires: SOC 2 Type II PDF, ISO network diagram, and a signed pen-test attestation before we hand over creds. They want this fast. Who can take point?
Omar (SE): I can gather the tech artifacts. Clarify: do they need the full SOC2 PDF or just the control matrix + executive summary?
Helena (Security): We only release full SOC2 under NDA. We can give an executive summary + control narratives publicly. For pen-test attestation we have a standard attestation; Legal needs to sign. We never share raw intrusion logs.
Jon (Legal): I'll sign once Security confirms the language. Helena, please paste the attestation draft and preferred phrasing about redacted reports vs full report under NDA.
pricing-bot: Quick estimate: Hosted POC = baseline. Dedicated isolated pool roughly +30% for short-term reserved capacity. VPC peering + static IPs require additional network engineering time.
Nina (AE): Thanks — their SRE asked whether customer-managed KMS is possible for the POC.
Helena (Security): For Hosted we can't offer customer-managed HSM. Dedicated can support CMK in a restricted form (customer keys stored in their KMS, integrated via vault). We'll provide an attestation describing key separation.
Omar (SE): Operational note: if they insist on VPC peering + allowlisted egress, estimate 4-6 business days to provision and test. Hosted on shared infra we can create short-lived API keys within 48h.
Nina (AE): I'll push for Hosted to hit the 48-72h window. If they push Dedicated, we need to surface the cost/time trade-off immediately.
Helena (Security): Posting pen-test attestation template now:
```
Pen-Test Attestation (Redwood Inference)
- Customer: <NewLeaf>
- Environment: staging (short-lived test tenant)
- Scope: API endpoints, auth, selected data flows (see scope appendix)
- Assessment: Third-party security assessment conducted on <date>; high/critical findings addressed or accepted with compensating controls
- Report Access: Full findings report available to customer upon execution of an NDA; summary/redacted findings may be provided without NDA
- Signatory: Legal (authorized signatory)
```
Jon (Legal): That wording looks good. I prefer "available upon execution of an NDA" for clarity. I'll sign once Helena confirms final date and the scope line.
Omar (SE): Artifact checklist (draft):
- SOC2 Type II PDF (provided under NDA)
- SOC2 mapping/control narratives (redacted ok)
- ISO network diagram (standard, with optional VPC-peering callouts)
- Pen-test attestation (signed)
- Short-lived staging API key + presigned SFTP for artifact upload
Nina (AE): Action items: 1) Helena: final attestation + confirm redaction line. 2) Omar: assemble ISO diagram and checklist. 3) Jon: pre-approve signatory text. 4) Me: request CIDR and NDA from NewLeaf, push for Hosted if they accept the constraints.
pricing-bot: Note: If NewLeaf requests dedicated VLAN + CMK, estimate preliminary quote of +$X/month (ops to follow up for exact).
Helena (Security): Confirmed: replace <date> with assessment month; "redacted findings may be provided without NDA" stands. I'll attach a short control narrative and recommended customer-facing text.
Omar (SE): Also confirm: who at NewLeaf to coordinate allowlist? Need contact + preferred test windows.
Nina (AE): Contact is infra-leads@newleaf.com (cc'd in email). I'll send NDA and request CIDR now. Will update thread with their decision on Hosted vs Dedicated. :pray:
